## Hex 2.1.23

- Keeps AirPods and other Bluetooth headsets in high-quality audio. When the
  microphone is set to Automatic and a headset is the macOS default input, HEX
  now uses the built-in microphone instead of switching the headset into its
  low-quality call mode. An explicitly selected headset is still used.
- Fixes a locked dictation that occasionally ignored the shortcut after a missed
  key release, which left Escape (and a discarded recording) as the only way out.
- Keeps the Settings window in front when you turn off Show Dock icon. The icon
  now stays while Settings is open and disappears when you close it.
- Lets administrators turn off in-app updates, including Check for Updates, with
  the `DisableUpdates` preference in the `com.kitlangton.hex2` domain.
- Opens Settings without loading the diagnostic activity log, and reads that log
  in bounded chunks when Commands or Activity need it.
- Checks Launch at Login status off the UI thread.
- Finds `opencode2` installed through Vite Plus.

This macOS maintenance release uses build 20123. The public TypeScript SDK
remains at 0.3.1. No Linux binary is published with this release.
